upgrading: A beta: a pre-release to try before v0.12.1. `upgrade` and the console's version chip never offer it and a fresh install never lands on it; reach it with `run.py upgrade --to v0.12.1-beta`. v0.12.1 will be an ordinary upgrade from it.

The portfolio tab's direction card has an ideas button: what drives your delta and the rolls that would move it either way without closing anything. A poor man's covered call is rolled under its own PMCC rules.
The PMCC tab lists PMCCs and undecided candidates only. A call calendar or diagonal that is not a PMCC is named in one line that opens the positions tab's new time spreads filter.
The wheel tab opens on active cycles, with open, waiting, complete and all one click away. The wheel and PMCC tabs switch between cards and rows.
The manage snapshot reads a few more broker chains (each put calendar's next expiries), inside the existing manage.roll_out cap.

config_changes.note: New and optional: the direction card's ideas (front_days, roll_short_delta, untested_short_delta, min_credit, new_spread). The defaults apply when it is absent.

upgrading: This is the first release with `run.py upgrade`. Moving from v0.11.x to v0.12.0 is manual (docs/guide/upgrading.md); from here on `upgrade` does it.

Earnings is paper-only: it cannot place orders, and a leftover `enable_live_trading` or `live` key does nothing. The manual desk and the QuikOptions integration are removed. Live orders now exist only in MEIC, flies and bwb.

flies, curve, pmcc and bwb ship switched off in the example configs. Your config is never rewritten, so a module you have on stays on until you switch it off. `/live-flies-start` and `/live-bwb-start` refuse while their module is off.
The arm gates new MEIC condors only: an unarmed `meic-live` still manages what it holds. MEIC live entries are one contract.
The scheduler merged daily jobs that run at several times into one job each, so 18 job ids leave `status`. Restart the supervisor after the upgrade.
The installer now sets up Dolt unless told not to (`-SkipDolt`) and runs `run.py bootstrap` at the end (`-SkipBootstrap` skips it). `-WithDesk` is accepted and ignored.
The console checks GitHub for a newer release at most every six hours; `update_check: false` in console.json turns that off.

morning-data and evening-data are two pipelines that replace 28 jobs in `status`; a failed landing step now stops the steps that read it, and per-step results are in state/pipeline.<name>.json. manage waits 60 seconds after a fill, takes no snapshot within 2 minutes of the last, and posts only when its action list changes.
manual_steps: Stop the suite (uninstall.cmd or ./uninstall.sh), get v0.12.0 (unzip into a new folder, never over the old one, or fetch tags and check out the tag), and run the installer again.

Run `python run.py doctor` and delete what it says is ignored: the earnings `enable_live_trading` or `live` key, the `quikoptions` and `desk_notify` blocks in config.json, and ~/.cherrypick/config/desk.json.
Switch off any retired module you still have on (`modules.<name>.enabled` false for flies, curve, pmcc and bwb).
Run `python run.py supervise --restart`, then restart any resident job, then `python run.py status` to see the two data pipelines.
